category_title: Students with persistent challenging behavior referred for individualized support
minimal_context: The student is sitting at their desk during independent work time to complete a math worksheet.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please start working on your independent math worksheet. You need to complete the first five problems.

STUDENT: (Puts head down on desk) I don't want to do this.

TUTOR: You need to finish your work. Just try the first one.

STUDENT: (Leaves seat without permission) No, I'm not doing it.

TUTOR: Please sit back down and look at your math paper.

STUDENT: (Shouts) I said I'm not doing it! (Rips the math worksheet and throws it on the floor)

options.A: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time with the math worksheet.
options.B: Deliver verbal directives, questions, or stimuli that specify an observable student response.
options.C: Break the math worksheet down into smaller chunks so the problems can be completed.
options.D: Ensure that no attention is given to the student during the challenging behavior.
